scope: Immutable numeric grammar classifications for native syntax traversal; checked consumed text, all per-node source-range checks, parser lifetimes, recovery rejection and admissions retained. Local macOS aarch64.
changes: Derive classifications for every actual grammar symbol ID, including aliases with the same name; no hardcoded grammar IDs or repeated per-node native kind-name conversion.

One OnceLock table per pinned JS/TS/TSX grammar retains only Rust enum values for process lifetime. Metadata is bounded by linked grammar size, independent of input; source, parser, node and tree handles remain file-local.
Validate every visited node range and every consumed literal/identifier via checked UTF-8 slicing with a typed parse error; retain source-u32/work admission and whole-tree recovery rejection.
Expand semantic fuzzing with a separate bounded nested-call program (nine literal edges per grammar), retaining the original 256-scalar bound and 7/20/18-edge programs.
Reject job-scoped parser reuse and removing per-node checks after isolated pilots; final production changes only src/module_syntax.rs.

new_regressions: nested runtime edges across all three grammars and initialization orders
type-name decoys and transparent runtime wrappers
short source buffers and split UTF-8 ranges using a real native node
96-file mixed JS/TS/TSX ring at one and four workers, followed by a fresh scan after a source edit

harnesses.source:
"""Run sequential normal-binary comparisons after checks and builds have exited."""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import subprocess
import sys

area=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
assert 'HOTPATH_OUTPUT_PATH' not in os.environ
for workload in ['fan-in','call-heavy','monorepo','directory-index']:
    command=[sys.executable,'-B','scripts/benchmark.py','--binary',str(area/'after-jscycles'),'--baseline',str(area/'before-jscycles'),'--workload',workload,'--files','10000','--samples','21','--output',str(area/f'{workload}-comparison.json')]
    if workload=='monorepo': command += ['--packages','64','--aliases','4096']
    print('Running',command,flush=True)
    subprocess.run(command,check=True,timeout=180)

performance.method: 21 alternating samples plus one warm-up per saved normal binary on each same corpus; complete JSON byte equality. All builds/checks/Miri/mutants/fuzzing exited successfully before final normal timing; instrumented profiling followed timing. Normal release binary restored and matched the saved final digest.
performance.limits: Dense syntax median 2.7% lower; standard controls vary within 1.3%. Warm local synthetic evidence only: no universal speedup, statistical significance, cold-cache, customer budget, madge comparison or cross-platform claim.

unchanged.note: Imports/resolution/source I/O, workspace/tsconfig, dependencies, manifests, locks, maintenance commands and mutation policy remain byte-identical to the preceding pass. Parser allocation/lifetime and every visited-node range check are retained.

limitations: Other supported platforms and hosted GitHub execution were not run locally.
No full Rust-OE certification, hostile-filesystem confinement, parser isolation, commit, push or publication.
